hero.headline: Framer vs Wix
hero.subheadline: A side-by-side comparison for buyers, operators, and affiliate-content readers.

summary.best_for_a: Framer is best for designers and product teams who want pixel-perfect control, modern interactions, and a lightweight code-forward site.
summary.best_for_b: Wix is best for beginners, small businesses, and anyone who wants an all-in-one solution with templates, apps, and easy e-commerce setup.
summary.quick_take: Framer delivers a design-first experience with advanced layout controls, modern animations, and clean output that appeals to designers and developers who value performance and customization. Wix offers a full-featured, user-friendly platform with a large template library, an app marketplace, and guided tools that make launching stores, portfolios, and local business sites fast and straightforward. Choose Framer when design fidelity and fast, minimal sites matter; choose Wix when you want an easy, feature-packed path to a live site without handing off tasks to developers.

paragraphs: Framer and Wix are both popular website builders, but they target different priorities. Framer emphasizes design control, motion, and clean front-end output, while Wix prioritizes accessibility, a broad feature set, and quick time-to-launch with minimal setup.

Deciding between them comes down to trade-offs: Framer offers greater design fidelity and performance-friendly output, whereas Wix provides more built-in tools, templates, and an app marketplace that helps small businesses and nontechnical users get online fast.

data.headline: Framer for design precision, Wix for out-of-the-box convenience
data.summary: If your priority is control, modern interactions, and a lightweight production site, Framer is the stronger pick. If you need broad features, templates, integrated apps, and an easier setup for nontechnical users, Wix wins. Both are capable builders—pick the one that matches your workflow and growth needs.

items.question: Which platform produces faster-loading sites?
items.answer: Framer generally produces lighter, faster pages by design, while Wix sites can be fast but may slow down as you add apps and complex features.

items.question: Can I run an online store on both platforms?
items.answer: Yes — Wix includes built-in e-commerce tools for full store management. Framer can support e-commerce via integrations or custom setups but lacks Wix's out-of-the-box store features.

items.question: Which is easier for a nontechnical user?
items.answer: Wix is easier for nontechnical users thanks to its drag-and-drop editor, templates, and guided tools; Framer is more designer-oriented and may require more time to learn.

items.question: Can I export code or host elsewhere?
items.answer: Framer provides cleaner front-end export and developer options for hosting elsewhere; Wix is a fully managed platform and does not offer the same easy code export.

items.question: How do they compare for SEO?
items.answer: Both offer SEO tools, but Framer's speed and clean markup help technical SEO, while Wix provides built-in SEO guidance and easy-to-use on-page controls for beginners.

items.question: Which is a better long-term choice for growing businesses?
items.answer: If you prioritize rapid scaling with built-in business tools, Wix is convenient. If you need performance, design control, and developer-friendly output as you scale, Framer may be the better long-term choice.
